name: Vepay Card
summary: Simple crypto card with flat 2% top-up fee. No monthly fees, no hidden charges. Load with USDT on TRC-20 or ERC-20. Virtual card for global spending.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Vepay Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Vepay Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
